{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas
# Check if any revenue values contain commas
print('Revenue contains commas:', df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any())

df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'QA orders found: {qa_count}')

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f'Refunded orders found: {refunded_count}')

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask]
print(f'Rows after filtering: {filtered_df.shape[0]} out of 900')

# Check raw conversion rate by channel
raw_conv = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('Raw conversion rate by channel:')
print(raw_conv)

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
segment_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:')
print(segment_by_channel)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'customer_age == -1: {age_neg1_count} rows')"}
